//: Gamma and whitepoint live HERE, not in the fclights engine.
//dither: Leave fcserver's own dithering and interpolation enabled; they are the reason this rig uses a Fadecandy at all.
//devices: One board, OPC channel 0 (broadcast), 512 pixels. Each entry is [OPC channel, first OPC pixel, first board pixel, pixel count]; fclights sends every board a frame already indexed by board pixel, so the mapping is always the identity and `fclights check` prints the exact entries for your layout. To add a second board give each one its own serial and its own OPC channel (1, 2, ...) and match those channels in layout.json.
